description: Central MCP server registry for Huxley. Config lives in .mcp.json (project) and ~/.claude.json (user); this file only carries category/description metadata. Keep it in sync with .mcp.json when you add or remove servers.

filesystem.description: Filesystem access scoped to the Huxley root (read/write/search)

builder-memory.description: Knowledge-graph memory (entities, relations, observations) for build sessions

context7.description: Up-to-date library documentation for LLM context (24k+ libraries)

google-workspace.description: Google Workspace MCP (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) via uvx + browser OAuth — remove from .mcp.json if unused

planner.description: Project planning and analysis (uses gh CLI for GitHub)

reviewer.description: Code review and quality assessment (uses gh CLI for GitHub)

frontend-specialist.description: Frontend development and UI (shadcn via CLI + Context7)

backend-specialist.description: Backend API development (uses supabase CLI for database, gh CLI for GitHub)

executor.description: Task execution (uses gh CLI for GitHub operations)

user.description: Attached to your Claude account / machine, not the repo — register your own here
